Fictional Agent test policy - page 3
Aster Labs fictional commuting allowance policy, current from 2026-01-01. Eligibility
requires full-time employment and at least 3 on-site workdays per week. Submit an
employment-type declaration and an on-site work schedule. Self-reported facts can support
only a conditional eligibility assessment, subject to employer confirmation.
